name: TURBO TOWER BATTLES [NO COOLDOWN WEAPONS]
desc:
This is a MODDED version of the iconic Doomspire Brickbattle.
Original: https://www.roblox.com/games/1215581239/Doomspire-Brickbattle

Question: How to play? 
Answer: Knock out all of the enemy spawns until your team's spawns are the last ones remaining!

Question: What are the tricks to become a pro? 
Answer: To "bomb jump," lay a bomb and jump at the same time. You will go flying upward! To fly a long distance in any direction, you can lay a bomb and ride the explosive force. You can give yourself more air time while falling by using the sword's float when you lunge. You can use a rocket while falling to do a "rocket jump" to preserve your momentum. If you fall off the map, you can save yourself by placing a trowel wall below your feet, giving you a safe landing.

UPDATE: 24/02/24
 - NO MORE BOMB GRIEFING (SERVERS LAST LONGER)
- ADDED VOICE CHAT
- ADDED CAMERA FEATURE 

UPDATE: 5/03/24
-NORMAL BOMB RELOAD TIME IS NOW 25% LESS 

This game has PREMIUM BENEFITS : The Windforce Sword.

scripts.title: Auto Shots
scripts.script:
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = plr.Character
 while true do
     task.wait()
 for i, v in pairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("Tool") then
            v:Activate()
        end
    end
  for _, child in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("BasePart") then
      child.Massless = false
      child.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge) 
    end
  end
end
